requirement: Client/host path tie, gap refetch, default bearer, aria-busy, non-vacuous endpoint correlation

sharedPath.consumers: observability.ts and readback.ts import them; the test correlates all five with host index.ts/local-diagnostics-read.ts literals and with inventory hostEndpoints.

gapRefetch.behaviour: Revision gap (1 -> 3) now dispatches readObservability for the Observability route (and readReadback for readback routes), sets stale while loading, and clears stale on a successful result. No later event is needed.
gapRefetch.proof: S26f test mounts observability, emits 1 then 3, and expects fetch count 1 -> 2 -> 3 with one active source.

defaultToken.behaviour: createShellApp passes baseUrl/token/fetch into the default clients; a token-less config still sends none.
defaultToken.proof: S26f mounts without readObservability injection, provisions observabilityToken, captures fetch headers, and sees Authorization: Bearer s26f-default-token.

statusSemantics.messages: 401 -> 'Observability read failed: HTTP 401 (not authorized)'; 403 -> '... 403 (forbidden)'; other status retains reason.
statusSemantics.ariaBusy: Loading status paragraph carries aria-busy=true; asserted by S26f.

nonVacuousCorrelation.rule: Every read route must declare at least one hostEndpoint; all declared endpoints on non-required rows must exist in the parsed host table.
nonVacuousCorrelation.proof: S26a drift test fails when dashboard endpoints are removed; all read routes now declare present endpoints.
